_about: Licence of each shared file (licences are never part of file names). Each rule gives a licence code from assets/naming.json (CCBY, CCBYNC, CC0, MIT, STUDY, ARR, ...) and either a 'path' (one file, or a folder ending in /) or an 'id' (a file ID, or the start of one). The most specific match wins. Files with no matching rule and no licence notice inside them are shown as 'no licence stated'.
